text:
Maria Santos: Heads up — we're rolling a compact pricing schema on Mon (00:00 UTC). It collapses legacy per-model SKUs into commit buckets (S / M / L / XL). This will change quoting SKU names and the pricing-service lookup keys. Quick summary below. :megaphone:

Kevin Li: do we have a migration path for active POCs? can deals keep old SKUs until contract sign?

Maria Santos: short answer: yes. grandfathering is available for active signed quotes + POCs in progress if ops flag is set. Exceptions need deal-desk signoff.

Anya Patel: what's the process to request grandfathering — a form or a PR?

DealDeskBot: New Exception Request template: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/grandfathering-request (please attach the signed quote & POC timeline).

Liam O'Connor: will the CPQ lookup key change? our integrators currently use price_key="model_<name>_v1"

Maria Santos: CPQ will map old keys to new commit buckets for a 30-day overlap window. We'll publish a mapping CSV and push a compatibility layer to pricing-service.

Kevin Li: can we do a temporary discount override for POCs? some customers need 90d trial pricing.

Maria Santos: yes — discount overrides are allowed up to 35% for POC-only scenarios. Requires deal-desk approval. >35% needs Anya + Liam + legal review.

Anya Patel: who owns updating the rate file (ratecard JSON) and pushing to pricing-service? engineering or sales_ops?

Liam O'Connor: eng-infra will deploy the pricing-service change, but we need the final signed rate file from sales_ops to avoid rollbacks. Ops will not deploy without that file.

Maria Santos: timeline: draft posted Fri EOD, internal freeze Mon 12:00 UTC, public go-live Mon 00:00 UTC. If you have any active deals that might be impacted, flag them now. :eyes:

Kevin Li: small ask — include a column for "commit_duration" in the mapping CSV (helps quoting script).

Maria Santos: noted — will include commit_duration + legacy_key columns.

DealDeskBot: Reminder: submit exceptions via the template or responses will be delayed. :warning:

Anya Patel: I'll start the legal loop for enterprise terms today.

Maria Santos: thanks all. Ping me directly for urgent POCs; otherwise use the template so DealDeskBot can triage. Cheers. :party:
